mutation.adapter: Map Stryker files[]/mutants[] into targets[]: one target per file, killed/survived/timeout counts from mutant status, equivalent mutants excluded from the denominator.

notes: Copy this file to quality-gate.config.json in the adopting repository root and keep mutation.report at artifacts/mutation-report.json.
The shipped quality-gate.yml passes this file to mutation_gate.py run --config on every pull request and trunk push; MUTATION_COMMAND is only a fallback.
Cucumber.js is the industry-standard BDD runner for Node.js and writes JUnit XML through --format junit:<path>.
Stryker is the industry-standard mutation testing framework for JavaScript and TypeScript.
The adapter normalizes Stryker's reports/mutation/mutation.json into the report consumed by mutation_gate.py and Gate 3.
Add services: or testcontainers when acceptance tests require real middleware.
Never mark a gate command non-blocking or ignore its exit code.
